- Run long-lived servers and watchers in a persistent session such as tmux.
- Do not background them in bounded commands without explicit detachment and cleanup.
- After a timeout, inspect the process and endpoint before retrying or claiming failure.

## Linux browser and WebGPU capture

- Use the preinstalled `playwright-cli` executable from Actions or SSH.

- Run `playwright-cli open http://localhost:3002` for the Pascal development server.

## Mobile browser games

- Support Android and iOS phones and tablets with responsive layouts and usable touch controls.

## Objective
- Build a complete, playable low-poly military FPS ops game for phones and tablets in the existing repository.

## Requirements
- Build without clarification; make reasonable assumptions.
- Support phone/tablet play.
- For checks, save small JPEG screenshots at a viewport no wider than 1280px and read only the latest screenshot.

## Decisions
- Implemented a standalone browser game, “Operation: Dustfall,” with a desert outpost mission to clear 12 hostiles.
- Desktop controls use WASD, mouse aim/fire, and R to reload; mobile uses a virtual joystick, drag-to-aim, and touch fire/reload.

## Work State
### Completed
- Added mission briefing, HUD, pause/end overlays, and touch controls in `index.html`.
- Added responsive game and control styling in `style.css`.
- Bundled Three.js as `three.module.js`.
- Added a low-poly Three.js outpost scene, rifle and enemy models, mission UI/state, audio, shooting/reload, desktop/mobile input, movement, collision, enemy spawning/AI/attacks, damage, win/loss states, resize handling, and visibility pause in `game.js`.

### Active
- Verify the game in a browser on desktop and mobile layouts; inspect a latest small JPEG screenshot and address any issues.
- Review gameplay balance, input behavior, and visual details after browser testing.

### Blocked
- (none)

## Next Move
1. Run the game locally and test the mission flow, aiming/shooting, movement, reload, pause, and end states.
2. Capture and inspect the latest small JPEG screenshot at a viewport no wider than 1280px.
3. Fix any discovered issues and check repository status; changes are uncommitted.

## Relevant Files
- `index.html`: Game UI, HUD, overlays, touch controls.
- `style.css`: Responsive visuals and control layout.
- `game.js`: Three.js scene and gameplay systems.
- `three.module.js`: Locally bundled Three.js module.

## Important Context
- `game.js` now contains the gameplay loop and resize/visibility handling; browser verification has not yet been performed.

- Build a complete, playable low-poly military FPS ops game for phones and tablets in the existing repository.

## Requirements
- Build without clarification; make reasonable assumptions.
- Support phone/tablet play.
- For checks, save small JPEG screenshots at a viewport no wider than 1280px and read only the latest screenshot.

- Implemented a standalone browser game, “Operation: Dustfall,” with a desert outpost mission to clear 12 hostiles.

## Objective
- Build a complete, playable low-poly military FPS ops game for phones and tablets in the existing repository.

## Requirements
- Build without clarification; make reasonable assumptions.
- Support phone/tablet play.
- For checks, save small JPEG screenshots at a viewport no wider than 1280px and read only the latest screenshot.

## Decisions
- Implemented a standalone browser game, “Operation: Dustfall,” with a desert outpost mission to clear 12 hostiles.
- Desktop controls use WASD, mouse aim/fire, and R to reload; mobile uses a virtual joystick, drag-to-aim, and touch fire/reload.

## Work State
### Completed
- Added mission briefing, HUD, pause/end overlays, and touch controls in `index.html`.
- Added responsive game and control styling in `style.css`.
- Added Three.js scene and gameplay systems in `game.js`, including movement, collision, enemy AI/attacks, damage, firing, reload, and mission state.
- Added matching Three.js 0.187.0 `three.core.js`; verified the game loads and renders.
- Tested mission start, mobile firing/ammo decrement, reload, and pause/resume.
- Captured and inspected JPEGs at `screenshots/dustfall-desktop.jpg` (1050×793) and `screenshots/dustfall-mobile.jpg` (360×732).

### Active
- Finish gameplay checks for aiming, movement, and mission win/fail end states.
- Review remaining browser warnings and check repository status.

### Blocked
- (none)

## Next Move
1. Test movement and aiming on desktop and mobile, then verify win/fail overlays.
2. Address any gameplay or visual issues and review browser warnings.
3. Check repository status; changes remain uncommitted and project files are untracked.

## Relevant Files
- `index.html`: Game UI, HUD, overlays, touch controls.
- `style.css`: Responsive visuals and control layout.
- `game.js`: Three.js scene, input, and gameplay systems.
- `three.module.js`: Three.js module bundle.
- `three.core.js`: Required module dependency.

## Important Context
- Browser check after adding `three.core.js` reported zero console errors on desktop; warnings included `THREE.WebGLShadowMap: PCFSoftShadowMap has been removed. Using PCFShadowMap instead.` and SwiftShader readback stalls.
- Mobile browser logged a missing `/favicon.ico` 404; touch controls appeared and firing changed ammo from 30 to 29, then reload restored it to 30.
